rkesteva AI Threads 46m Given how unreliable AI code is, I think we’re going to need new processes to check it before it goes to prod. So for any code it writes, I now make my AI open a request before pushing (I call these “push requests”). I review the code and leave comments, then it fixes them. I then have run some automated tests before merging to check and make sure we don’t break anything we’ve broken before.
